CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accept_manager_trade(p_trade_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_trade        public.manager_trade_offers%ROWTYPE;
  v_offered_p    public.manager_tournament_players%ROWTYPE;
  v_requested_p  public.manager_tournament_players%ROWTYPE;
  v_group_id     UUID := gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
  -- 1. Lock trade row
  SELECT * INTO v_trade
  FROM public.manager_trade_offers
  WHERE id = p_trade_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'accept_manager_trade: trade % not found', p_trade_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_trade.status <> 'PENDING' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'accept_manager_trade: trade % is not PENDING (status=%)', p_trade_id, v_trade.status;
  END IF;

  -- 2. Lock both player rows
  SELECT * INTO v_offered_p
  FROM public.manager_tournament_players
  WHERE id = v_trade.offered_player_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  SELECT * INTO v_requested_p
  FROM public.manager_tournament_players
  WHERE id = v_trade.requested_player_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  -- 3. Verify current ownership matches what the trade assumed
  IF v_offered_p.current_team_id <> v_trade.from_team_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'accept_manager_trade: offered player % ownership changed (expected team %, actual %)',
      v_trade.offered_player_id, v_trade.from_team_id, v_offered_p.current_team_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_requested_p.current_team_id <> v_trade.to_team_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'accept_manager_trade: requested player % ownership changed (expected team %, actual %)',
      v_trade.requested_player_id, v_trade.to_team_id, v_requested_p.current_team_id;
  END IF;

  -- 4. Swap ownership
  UPDATE public.manager_tournament_players
  SET current_team_id = v_trade.to_team_id,
      ownership_status = 'OWNED',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = v_trade.offered_player_id;

  UPDATE public.manager_tournament_players
  SET current_team_id = v_trade.from_team_id,
      ownership_status = 'OWNED',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = v_trade.requested_player_id;

  -- 5. Accept trade
  UPDATE public.manager_trade_offers
  SET status = 'ACCEPTED',
      resolved_at = NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_trade_id;

  -- 6. Insert two transfer transaction rows
  INSERT INTO public.manager_transfer_transactions
    (tournament_id, player_id, from_team_id, to_team_id, type,
     related_trade_id, transaction_group_id)
  VALUES
    (v_trade.tournament_id, v_trade.offered_player_id,
     v_trade.from_team_id, v_trade.to_team_id, 'TRADE',
     p_trade_id, v_group_id),
    (v_trade.tournament_id, v_trade.requested_player_id,
     v_trade.to_team_id, v_trade.from_team_id, 'TRADE',
     p_trade_id, v_group_id);

  -- 7. Audit event
  INSERT INTO public.manager_tournament_events
    (tournament_id, event_type, actor_user_id, metadata)
  VALUES (
    v_trade.tournament_id,
    'TRADE_ACCEPTED',
    p_actor_user_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'trade_id',           p_trade_id,
      'transaction_group_id', v_group_id,
      'offered_player_id',  v_trade.offered_player_id,
      'requested_player_id', v_trade.requested_player_id,
      'from_team_id',       v_trade.from_team_id,
      'to_team_id',         v_trade.to_team_id
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'trade_id',            p_trade_id,
    'transaction_group_id', v_group_id,
    'offered_player_id',   v_trade.offered_player_id,
    'requested_player_id', v_trade.requested_player_id
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.change_player_ownership(p_player_id uuid, p_to_team_id uuid, p_transaction_type text, p_amount_units bigint, p_actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_player    public.manager_tournament_players%ROWTYPE;
  v_new_status TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_player
  FROM public.manager_tournament_players
  WHERE id = p_player_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'change_player_ownership: player % not found', p_player_id;
  END IF;

  v_new_status := CASE WHEN p_to_team_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'OWNED' ELSE 'FREE_AGENT' END;

  UPDATE public.manager_tournament_players
  SET current_team_id  = p_to_team_id,
      ownership_status = v_new_status,
      updated_at       = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_player_id;

  INSERT INTO public.manager_transfer_transactions
    (tournament_id, player_id, from_team_id, to_team_id, type, amount_units)
  VALUES (
    v_player.tournament_id,
    p_player_id,
    v_player.current_team_id,
    p_to_team_id,
    p_transaction_type,
    p_amount_units
  );

  INSERT INTO public.manager_tournament_events
    (tournament_id, event_type, actor_user_id, player_id, metadata)
  VALUES (
    v_player.tournament_id,
    'PLAYER_TRANSFERRED',
    p_actor_user_id,
    p_player_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'from_team_id',   v_player.current_team_id,
      'to_team_id',     p_to_team_id,
      'type',           p_transaction_type,
      'amount_units',   p_amount_units,
      'new_status',     v_new_status
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'player_id',     p_player_id,
    'from_team_id',  v_player.current_team_id,
    'to_team_id',    p_to_team_id,
    'new_status',    v_new_status
  );
END;
$function$
